title: Design & spec minirag-mcp v1
description: Brainstorm -> design doc -> spec review. Python rewrite of shinpr/mcp-local-rag: fastmcp + markitdown (ingest, recursive dir scan) + trafilatura (HTML main-content extraction, markitdown fallback) + fastembed (default paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2) + LanceDB (hybrid search). v1 scope: MCP server (9 tools, parity) + CLI (same index, typer/argparse). No PDF visual mode, no ingest_url. All docs and functionality in English.
